descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 观察自转中的地球：昼夜半球、晨昏线与太阳直射点位置。
descriptionI18n.en: Watch a rotating Earth: day/night hemispheres, terminator and the subsolar point.

teachingI18n.zh-CN: 太阳直射赤道，全球昼夜平分。
teachingI18n.en: The Sun is overhead at the equator and day equals night everywhere.

teachingI18n.zh-CN: 太阳直射北回归线 23.5°N，北半球昼最长。
teachingI18n.en: The Sun is overhead at 23.5°N; the northern hemisphere has its longest day.

teachingI18n.zh-CN: 太阳直射赤道，全球昼夜平分。
teachingI18n.en: The Sun is overhead at the equator and day equals night everywhere.

teachingI18n.zh-CN: 太阳直射南回归线 23.5°S，北半球昼最短。
teachingI18n.en: The Sun is overhead at 23.5°S; the northern hemisphere has its shortest day.

bodyI18n.zh-CN: 从北极上空看，地球逆时针转动；转一圈用 23 小时 56 分 4 秒。
bodyI18n.en: Seen from above the north pole the Earth turns counter-clockwise, once every 23 h 56 min.

bodyI18n.zh-CN: 晨昏线（白色虚线）把地球分成昼半球与夜半球，交替周期 24 小时。
bodyI18n.en: The terminator (white dashes) splits the lit and dark hemispheres; one cycle takes 24 h.

bodyI18n.zh-CN: 黄色圆环标出太阳光垂直照射的位置，它随季节在南北回归线之间往返。
bodyI18n.en: The yellow ring marks where sunlight strikes vertically — it drifts between the tropics over a year.

bodyI18n.zh-CN: 地轴与黄道面法线成 23.5°，倾斜方向不变，这是四季与五带划分的根本原因。
bodyI18n.en: The axis is tilted 23.5° from the ecliptic normal and keeps its direction — the root cause of seasons.
